family_designs.break_old_shortcuts: Remove fixed slot sign, magnitude, branch order and printed-last-number correlations; floor tests include credit-minus-debit skeleton and copy extremes.
family_designs.mechanism_A: Random mixed-sign account journals with cancellations/zero/negative totals; query chosen after accounts and layout are permuted.
family_designs.mechanism_B: Transfer-event network with debit/credit conservation plus opening balance, independently implemented rather than another spelling of the same fixed entry list.
family_designs.solver_pair: Independent integer journal reducer vs transfer/conservation reconstruction from parsed visible text.

family_designs.break_old_shortcuts: Randomize truth-bearing roles and query symbols; no firsttwo-branches implyYES rule; query-blind RHS-presence floor mandatory.
family_designs.mechanism_A: Random bounded Horn DAG with shared intermediates and conjunction; closed-world YES iff the requested proposition is derivable.
family_designs.mechanism_B: Relation/reachability composition with decoys and independent proof construction; explicit closed-world contract matches YES/NO scoring.
family_designs.solver_pair: Forward fixed-point closure vs independent backwards proof/reachability verifier.

family_designs.break_old_shortcuts: Avoid fixed chains and fixed queried-register offsets; balance final value sign/magnitude; exclude undefined division/overflow by semantic construction, not model performance.
contract_coverage: display order independent of execution order
family_designs.mechanism_A: Small sequential register language with reassignment, mixed arithmetic and copy dependencies; numbered execution order explicit.
family_designs.mechanism_B: Stack/state-machine trace with bounded conditional branch and explicit state transitions, independent generator semantics.
family_designs.solver_pair: Parsed small-step interpreter vs independent symbolic/equational trace, exact integer arithmetic.

family_designs.break_old_shortcuts: Answerability cannot follow speaker index, variantID, max printed number, or any-clear cue; query-blind lastentity and memory skeleton floors.
contract_coverage: latest values independent of numeric magnitude
family_designs.mechanism_A: Speaker-owned event histories with SET/CLEAR/QUOTE and later restoration; operation order independent of printed order.
family_designs.mechanism_B: Message/acknowledgement ownership state with quoted speech/distractor speakers, independently implemented event semantics.
family_designs.solver_pair: Chronological owner-state reducer vs independent last-effective-event backward trace.

family_designs.break_old_shortcuts: Do not encode status in entity order/value/length/header; guard recognizes only frozen supported syntax, logs unit fallback on new syntax without rewriting after results.
contract_coverage: raw approved count balanced across query states
family_designs.mechanism_A: Approved-record consensus with explicit current-date policy and balanced answer/missing/conflict queried entities.
family_designs.mechanism_B: Versioned authorized snapshot reconciliation with authority/date precedence stated in plain contract, independent evidence graph and renderer.
family_designs.solver_pair: Parsed authoritative grouping/consensus reducer vs independent certificate checker for selected evidence, absence or incompatible values.

family_designs.break_old_shortcuts: Neither variant1 nor a fixed query role always meansUNKNOWN; status/family/parent/variant metadata never appears in model packets.
family_designs.mechanism_A: Matched evidence-bundle transfer between queried and distractor entities with complete global record counts held fixed.
family_designs.mechanism_B: Independent source-retraction or authorization-counterfactual world with query/authority relationship changed and explicit contradiction contract.
family_designs.solver_pair: Source-consistency certificate verifier vs independent reference resolution/constraint checker.
